{{Quote|War is good for business!|[[Director/Legends|Director]] [[Zoltan Starkid]], upon seeing the remains of his [[Millennium Astro-Engineering plant|factory complex]]|<ref name="TFOTF" />}}
The '''attack on Tharkos''' was a battle of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was carried out by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] after [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] tipped off the Rebels about a deal between [[Millennium Astro-Engineering]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
Before the attack, Han Solo paid [[Zoltan Starkid]]'s [[Zoltan Starkid's personal secretary|personal secretary]] 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to learn when and where he could steal the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], a prototype of Millennium Astro-Engineering's latest craft.

Two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] later, Han Solo and two other [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] intercepted a group of Imperials in charge of flying the prototype to its new home, where it would be modified by [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] before Millennium Astro-Engineering could begin its production. Disguising himself as an [[TIE pilot|Imperial test pilot]], Han Solo entered [[Millennium Astro-Engineering plant]] and stole the ''Millennium Falcon''.
{{Noncanonend}}

Disliking people who dealt with the Empire, the Rebel Alliance sent three [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] to destroy Millennium Astro-Engineering factory complex on [[Tharkos]]. After the attack, Han Solo and his two fellow smugglers headed for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mazuma]] to recover 200,000 credits at [[Lucre Cosminational Bank]], courtesy of [[Starfighter Command (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Rebel Fighter Command]] for their efforts.
